metadata.question: Was there snow present in the Atacama Desert during the months of June and July in 2025?

data.raw_code: The question: "Was there snow present in the Atacama Desert during the months of June and July in 2025?" Analysis needed: 1. Time: June-July 2025 (2025-06-01 to 2025-07-31) 2. Location: Atacama Desert (approximate bounding box) 3. Detection: Need to identify snow presence using satellite imagery 4. Best data source: MODIS snow cover product (MOD10A1) is specifically designed for snow detection and has daily coverage - Alternative: Sentinel-2 with NDSI calculation, but MODIS is more reliable for snow monitoring Strategy: 1. Use MODIS Terra snow cover daily product (MOD10A1.061) 2. Check for any snow pixels (NDSI_Snow_Cover > 0 or > threshold) in the region during the period 3. If no MODIS data, try Sentinel-2 with NDSI calculation as fallback 4. Need to handle potential data gaps (2025 might not be fully available in some collections) Specific steps: - Define Atacama Desert region (approximate bounding box: -25.0, -70.0, -20.0, -67.0) - Filter MOD10A1 collection by date and region - Check if collection has images - Process: Use 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' band, threshold > 0 indicates snow - Count snow pixels in region - If count > 0, answer A; else B - Handle edge cases (no data, no valid pixels) Important considerations: - MODIS snow cover product already handles cloud masking to some extent - Use conservative threshold to avoid false positives - Check pixel count to ensure we have valid data ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Atacama Desert region (approximate bounding box) var atacama = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-71.0, -27.0, -68.0, -18.0]); // 2. Define time period: June and July 2025 var startDate = '2025-06-01'; var endDate = '2025-07-31'; // 3. Try MODIS Terra snow cover product first (most appropriate for snow detection) var modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(atacama); var colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS Terra snow images:', colSize); if (colSize === 0) { // Try MODIS Aqua as fallback modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(atacama); colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS Aqua snow images:', colSize); } if (colSize === 0) { // No MODIS data, try Sentinel-2 with NDSI calculation console.log('No MODIS data, trying Sentinel-2...'); var s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(atacama) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); var s2Size = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log('Sentinel-2 images:', s2Size); if (s2Size === 0) { console.log('No images found in any collection.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process Sentinel-2: calculate NDSI for snow detection // NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR), snow when NDSI > 0.4 var s2WithSnow = s2Col.map(function(img) { // Cloud masking using QA60 band var qa = img.select('QA60'); var cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) // Bit 10: clouds .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); // Bit 11: cirrus var ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); var snowMask = ndsi.gt(0.4); // Conservative snow threshold // Apply cloud mask and return snow mask return snowMask.updateMask(cloudMask); }); // Create max composite (snow present at any time) var snowComposite = s2WithSnow.max(); // Count snow pixels var snowStats = snowComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: atacama, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); var snowCount = snowStats.get('NDSI').getInfo(); var validPixels = snowComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: atacama, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log('Sentinel-2 snow pixel count:', snowCount); console.log('Valid pixels in region:', validPixels); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (snowCount === null || snowCount === undefined || isNaN(snowCount)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (snowCount > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } return; } // 4. Process MODIS data // Select NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100, higher values = more snow) var snowCol = modisCol.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); // Create max composite (show maximum snow cover value for each pixel) var maxSnow = snowCol.max(); // Count pixels with any snow (NDSI_Snow_Cover > 0) var snowMask = maxSnow.gt(0); // Conservative: any snow detected // Get count of snow pixels var snowStats = snowMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: atacama, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); var snowCount = snowStats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); // Get count of valid (unmasked) pixels var validStats = maxSnow.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: atacama, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); var validPixels = validStats.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log('MODIS snow pixel count:', snowCount); console.log('Valid pixels in region:', validPixels); // 5. Validation and answer if (validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in MODIS data.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (snowCount === null || snowCount === undefined || isNaN(snowCount)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (snowCount > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
